scenarios.name: Bog'chada xayrli tong
scenarios.goal: Bola ertalab bog'chaga kelganda tarbiyachi bilan inglizcha salomlashadi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Men — Kabutar qushcha. Ertalab bog'chaga kelsak, tarbiyachimizga [en]Good morning![/en] deymiz. Keling, birga salomlashamiz!
scenarios.intro_en: Hello! It is morning. Let's say hello to our teacher!

scene.image_prompt: A smiling kindergarten teacher greeting a small child at the classroom door in the morning, sunny window, toys on shelves, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q_en: It is morning. What do you say?
questions.why_en: Yes! In the morning we say: Good morning!

questions.q_en: Your teacher says: Hello! What do you say?

scenarios.name: Ertalab oilam bilan
scenarios.goal: Bola uyda ertalab onasi va dadasi bilan inglizcha salomlashadi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushcha uyingizga uchib keldi. Ertalab uyg'ondik — onajon va dadajonga [en]Good morning![/en] deymiz!
scenarios.intro_en: Good morning! Let's say hello to Mum and Dad!

scene.image_prompt: A small child in pajamas greeting mum and dad at a cozy breakfast table in the morning, sunlight through the window, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q_en: It is morning. You see Mum. What do you say?

scenarios.name: Rasm darsida bo'yoq so'raymiz
scenarios.goal: Bola rasm darsida kerakli rangni so'raydi va rahmat aytadi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Bugun Kabutar qushcha bilan rasm chizamiz. Kerakli bo'yoqni so'rash uchun [en]Red, please.[/en] deymiz — sehrli so'z [en]please[/en] — «iltimos».

scene.image_prompt: A teacher handing a jar of red paint to a small child at a painting table with colorful paint pots and paper, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q: Sizga qizil bo'yoq kerak. Nima deysiz?
questions.q_en: You want red paint. What do you say?
The teacher gives you paint. What do you say?

scenarios.name: Mushukchamni boqaman
scenarios.goal: Bola uy hayvoni bilan inglizcha salomlashadi va unga ovqat beradi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushchaning do'sti — mushukcha qorni och! Keling, unga [en]Hi, cat![/en] deb ovqat beramiz.
scenarios.intro_en: Look! A hungry cat! Let's say hello and feed the cat.

scene.image_prompt: A small child putting a bowl of food in front of a fluffy happy kitten in a cozy kitchen, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.why_en: Good job! The cat says: Meow!

scenarios.name: Do'stimning tug'ilgan kuni
scenarios.goal: Bola do'stini tug'ilgan kuni bilan tabriklaydi va shamlarni sanaydi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Bugun do'stimizning tug'ilgan kuni! Kabutar qushcha bilan [en]Happy birthday![/en] deymiz va shamlarni sanaymiz.
scenarios.intro_en: It is a birthday party! Let's say: Happy birthday! Let's count!

scene.image_prompt: Two small children at a birthday party, one smiling in a party hat next to a table with three candles glowing, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q_en: It is your friend's birthday. What do you say?

scenarios.name: Do'stim bilan koptok o'ynaymiz
scenarios.goal: Bola do'stidan o'yinchoqni odob bilan oladi va rahmat aytadi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushcha o'yinni yaxshi ko'radi. Do'stimiz koptok beryapti — [en]Yes, please![/en] va [en]Thank you![/en] deymiz.
scenarios.intro_en: Let's play with a friend! Say: Yes, please! Thank you!

scene.image_prompt: Two small children playing on a playroom rug, one handing a colorful ball to the other, toy car and teddy nearby, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q_en: You want the teddy. What do you say?
Your friend gives you a ball. What do you say?

scenarios.name: Cho'milish vaqti
scenarios.goal: Bola cho'milishda tana a'zolarini inglizcha aytadi va onasining so'zini tushunadi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushcha ham suvda cho'milishni yaxshi ko'radi. Onajon [en]Bath time![/en] dedi — qo'llarimizni yuvamiz!
scenarios.intro_en: Bath time! Let's wash our hands!

scene.image_prompt: A happy small child in a bubble bath washing hands, mum smiling next to the tub, rubber duck floating, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q_en: Mum says: Wash your hands! What do you wash?
Mum says: Bath time! What do you say?

scenarios.name: Bog'chada tamaddi vaqti
scenarios.goal: Bola tamaddi vaqtida meva yoki ichimlikni odob bilan so'raydi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushchaning qorni och! Tamaddi vaqti keldi — [en]An apple, please.[/en] deb so'raymiz.
scenarios.intro_en: It is snack time! Say: An apple, please.

scene.image_prompt: A kindergarten teacher offering a plate with apples and bananas to a small child at a little table with a cup of milk, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q_en: You want an apple. What do you say?
You want milk. What do you say?
